topics.title: What travel-expense evidence can a virtual assistant prepare without deciding tax treatment?

topics.title: Where should a recruiting coordinator stop in an employment background-check workflow?
topics.decision: How a recruiting coordinator can prepare consent, status, and notice records without ordering unauthorized checks, interpreting reports, or making employment decisions.

topics.title: Can a research assistant compare local markets without hiding survey uncertainty?

topics.title: What can an ecommerce virtual assistant prepare when a product may be recalled?

topics.title: Can an executive assistant maintain a decision log without becoming the decision-maker?
